caseStudies.title: How NiFi Migrator AI Executes Migration with Precision
caseStudies.subtitle: The system uses a CrewAI architecture composed of specialized agents that work in sequence to analyze, convert, validate, and document every NiFi flow automatically. This collaboration ensures secure, traceable, and hands-free migrations.

cases.title: Analyzer Agent
cases.desc: This agent analyzes the NiFi 1.x flow line by line, identifying processors, controllers, relationships, and dependencies. It generates a structural graph that serves as the basis for automatic conversion.

cases.title: Converter Agent
cases.desc: Receives the structure from the Analyzer and transforms deprecated components into their NiFi 2.x equivalents. Applies compatibility rules, preserves configurations, and adapts properties to new versions.

cases.title: Critic Agent
cases.desc: Evaluates the conversion generated by the Converter. Compares the original and new flows, detects inconsistencies, and performs automatic adjustments using semantic reasoning and contextual validation.

cases.title: Validator Agent
cases.desc: Runs syntactic and logical tests on the converted flow to ensure all connections and references work correctly before generating the final report.

cases.title: Report Generator Agent
cases.desc: Generates a detailed technical report with analysis and conversion results. Includes equivalences, dependencies, observations, and optimization suggestions. The report can be downloaded as PDF or JSON.
